format: ogg vorbis, compression_level 0.5 (~q0.45), mono unless stereo=true
resolution: Audio.play(name) loads assets/audio/<name>.ogg or <name>_1.ogg.._4.ogg (max 4 variants per name)

conventions.fire: fire_<weapon_id> (3 variants, outdoor field tail baked in), fire_<weapon_id>_sup (suppressed), fire_<weapon_id>_far (heard from CAL.far metres)
conventions.fire_fallback: fire_<class> for pistol smg rifle shotgun sniper mg revolver; fire_<family> for 9x18 9x19 357 ak545 ak762 ar556 12ga_pump 12ga_semi bolt_762x54 dmr lmg smg_9x18 smg_9x19 vss sks; each with _sup and _far; fire_<class>_indoor for a concrete room
conventions.mech: mag_out_<fam> mag_in_<fam> bolt_back_<fam> bolt_forward_<fam> rack_<fam> with fam in pistol smg ak ar svd vss sks shotgun pkm; bolt_open/bolt_close (bolt-actions), pump_back/pump_forward/shotgun_pump, shell_insert, break_open/break_close, clip_load, belt_open_pkm/belt_load_pkm/belt_close_pkm, safety_click, safety_ak, fire_selector, dry_click, dry_click_rifle, jam, unjam, cock_revolver, revolver_open/close/eject, mag_load_round, mag_unload_round
conventions.casings: casing_<surface> (brass pistol/rifle), casing_rifle_<surface> (steel rifle cases), shell_<surface> (12 ga hulls); surface in concrete dirt wood metal
conventions.impacts: impact_<surface> for dirt gravel concrete brick metal metal_thick wood water flesh glass ash mud sand; ricochet, bullet_crack (supersonic snap), bullet_whiz (subsonic), hit_helmet, hit_armor
conventions.steps: step_<surface>, step_<surface>_sprint, step_<surface>_crouch (4 variants) for grass dirt mud gravel rock road concrete wood metal water sand snow; land, land_<surface>, jump
conventions.loops: entries with loop=true are seamless (crossfaded) and meant for Audio.loop(); set AudioStreamOggVorbis.loop = true at runtime
conventions.voices: mimic_radio/mimic_chatter/mimic_alert (phrases), mimic_scream, mimic_pain, mimic_death, mimic_spot, mimic_hunt, phantom_whisper, phantom_scream

arc_charge.desc: the arcs winding up before a discharge: a rising whine and thickening buzz

arc_hum.desc: 8 s: the electric anomaly's mains-like buzz with a moving resonance and random crackles

arc_zap.desc: a discharge between the nodes: snap, sizzle, a low thud

armor_pen.desc: a round through the vest: the cover fabric tears, the plate cracks, then the wet thud

artifact_hum.desc: 8 s: a generic artifact's hum (legacy name)

artifact_pickup.desc: an artifact taken in hand: a chord of glass partials and a shiver of air

artifact_pop.desc: an artifact bursting: a glassy pop, a resonance sweeping up, a shimmer

artifact_resonance.desc: an artifact answering the detector: a swell of its partials

backpack_close.desc: zip shut, the pack settling on the shoulders

backpack_open.desc: a pack swung round, a zip drawn open, the flap

bandage_use.desc: a bandage: the wrapper torn, gauze wound tight, tape

base_hum.desc: 8 s: fluorescent tubes and the generator through the wall (legacy name)

battery_swap.desc: the torch cap unscrewed, the dead cell shaken out, a fresh one dropped in, the cap back on

bed_sleep.desc: lying down on a cot: springs, cloth, a long breath out

belt_load_pkm.desc: a belt laid on the feed tray, links rattling

belt_open_pkm.desc: PKM feed cover unlatched and lifted

bleed_drip.desc: a drop of blood on cloth or a boot

bolt_close.desc: bolt-action: push forward and turn down

bolt_open.desc: bolt-action: lift and draw the bolt (Mosin, SV-98)

bolt_release_ar.desc: the AR bolt catch paddle: loud clack and the buffer spring

break_open.desc: the TOZ: lever over, barrels swing down, ejectors click

breath_exhausted.desc: 6 s: hard breathing after a sprint, voice on the exhale

bullet_crack.desc: a supersonic round passing close: the N-wave snap

bullet_whiz.desc: a subsonic round passing: a short doppler whoosh

cigarette.desc: a match struck, a drag, the exhale

click.desc: a small dead click (empty battery, nothing happens)

clip_load.desc: stripper clip: seat the clip, thumb five rounds down

cock_revolver.desc: a revolver hammer drawn back: ratchet clicks, cylinder indexing

container_locked.desc: a locked hasp: the padlock knocked against the plate twice, the lid not giving

container_open.desc: a metal box or ammo crate lid (legacy name; crate_open for wood)

crate_open.desc: a wooden crate lid levered up

crow.desc: a hooded crow, two or three caws

death.desc: the end: a fall, the last breath, a low tone sinking, static

debris_drift.desc: floating stones grinding against each other overhead

detector_close.desc: 1.5 s: touching distance — ticks blur into a buzz and a tone rises

detector_far.desc: 1.5 s: the detector at the edge of its range — a tick every second

detector_lock.desc: the Svarog naming the type: two rising beeps

detector_mid.desc: 1.5 s: closer — ticks every quarter second

detector_near.desc: 1.5 s: near — a fast chatter of ticks

detector_tick.desc: one Geiger-like tick of the Veer detector

distant_shot.desc: a single shot somewhere across the fields (mixed calibres)

distortion_hum.desc: 8 s: a distortion — the air itself detuned: two close tones beating, phasey noise, sub

distortion_warp.desc: stepping into a distortion: the world bending, a smeared tone falling and rising

door_metal_close.desc: a steel door slammed: the swing, the boom, the latch

door_metal_open.desc: a steel door: the handle, hinges groaning, a long swing

door_wood_close.desc: a wooden door pulled shut: creak, the frame, the latch

door_wood_open.desc: a wooden door: latch, the hinge's dry creak, the stop

drink.desc: a canteen: cap, gulps, the bottle's glug

drip.desc: a drop into a puddle in the bunker

drizzle.desc: 8 s: drizzle on leaves and a tin roof (legacy name)

drop_cloth.desc: dropping something cloth on the ground

drop_glass.desc: dropping something glass on the ground

drop_metal.desc: dropping something metal on the ground

drop_paper.desc: dropping something paper on the ground

drop_plastic.desc: dropping something plastic on the ground

drop_wood.desc: dropping something wood on the ground

dry_click_rifle.desc: a rifle hammer falling on nothing: heavier

eat.desc: bread and tushonka: tearing, chewing, a swallow

explosion_frag.desc: a fragmentation grenade close by: crack, sub, shrapnel whine, earth falling back

explosion_frag_indoor.desc: a grenade in a concrete room

explosion_gas.desc: a gas anomaly igniting: a whoomp and a roar of fire

filter_swap.desc: a gas-mask filter unscrewed (plastic threads), the new one on, one test breath

flashbang.desc: a stun grenade: a white crack and the ears ringing

fragment_chime_fast.desc: 4 s: the chime pulsing fast (3 Hz) and 6 % sharp, as it closes in

fragment_explode.desc: it touches you: a shock — sub, crack, ringing glass partials

fragment_pop.desc: one shot pops it: a bright glass burst

fragment_shatter.desc: a cluster breaking apart into shards

fragment_skitter.desc: a fragment darting: a glassy whoosh with ticks

gas_burst.desc: a pocket of gas bursting from the mud

gas_hiss.desc: 8 s: gas venting from the ground, with bubbling and a chemical whistle

gear_rustle.desc: turning: webbing, straps, a magazine knocking a pouch

generator_start.desc: the base generator coughing into life

gravity_drone.desc: 8 s: the gravity sink — 38 Hz beating with itself, a slow pull, debris grinding

grenade_hiss.desc: a live grenade's fuse: 3.5 s of hiss and sputter

hatch_close.desc: a bunker hatch dropped shut and dogged

hatch_open.desc: a bunker hatch: the wheel spun, dogs releasing, the hatch swung up

headlamp.desc: the headlamp's plastic switch, up by the ear

heat_roar.desc: 8 s: a heat spout — a low roaring flame with pressure surges

hit_armor.desc: a round stopped by a plate: a hard flat thwack

hit_helmet.desc: a round on a steel helmet: the ring

hurt_bullet.desc: hit by a round: the impact and the gasp

impact_ash.desc: a round into a mimic: dry, papery, a puff

impact_brick.desc: a round into brick: a lower knock, chips of clay

impact_concrete.desc: a round into concrete: sharp crack, chips, dust

impact_dirt.desc: a round into soil: thud and a spray of earth

impact_flesh.desc: a round into a body: wet slap, low thud

impact_glass.desc: a round through a pane: crack and a fall of shards

impact_gravel.desc: a round into gravel: crunch and scattering stones

impact_metal.desc: a round through sheet metal: bright tick, the panel booms and rings

impact_metal_thick.desc: a round on heavy steel: a dense tink and a dull thud, no ring

impact_mud.desc: a round into mud: wet slap, no debris

impact_sand.desc: a round into sand: soft thud and a hiss of grains

impact_water.desc: a round into water: a plip and a short splash

impact_wood.desc: a round into planks: knock and splinters

inventory_equip.desc: a piece of gear buckled on

jam.desc: a stovepipe: the action stops short with a dull double-stop

jump.desc: pushing off: cloth and a scuff

knife_draw.desc: a blade drawn from a sheath: leather, the edge singing off the throat of the scabbard

land.desc: landing from a jump: weight, boots, gear

land_hard.desc: a hard landing: the knees, a grunt

lock_open.desc: a lock giving: the cylinder turns, the bolt draws

locker_open.desc: a steel locker: the latch, the thin door swinging with a tinny rattle

lockpick.desc: a pick working a lock: scratches and pins

mag_load_round.desc: one cartridge pressed down into a magazine against the spring

mag_unload_round.desc: a round thumbed out of a magazine

mask_breath.desc: 6 s: breathing through a gas mask, valve clicks

mask_off.desc: a gas mask pulled off, a breath of open air

mask_on.desc: a gas mask pulled on: rubber, straps, the seal

medkit_use.desc: a medkit: zip, clasps, rummaging, a bandage, zip

melee_hit.desc: the blade going in: a wet punch and a tear

melee_hit_hard.desc: the blade on something hard: a skid and a chip

melee_swing.desc: a knife thrust: a short whip of air and cloth

metal_creak.desc: a distant sheet of roofing shifting in the wind

mimic_alert.desc: barked: contact / fire / back back / grenade

mimic_call.desc: squad talk: second, respond / can you hear me / they are here / don't shoot

mimic_call_b.desc: squad talk: pull back / I am hit / reloading / that's it, the end

mimic_chatter.desc: the wrong things it says: help me / it's cold / home / this is not me — doubled, ring-modulated, a reversed tail

mimic_death.desc: it folds: a falling groan, static collapsing to nothing, ash settling

mimic_grenade.desc: the tell: a squelch, 'granata', the pin

mimic_hit.desc: a round lands in it: dry papery impact and a spit of static

mimic_hunt.desc: low, searching: where is he / he is close / come here / quiet

mimic_radio.desc: radio procedure words: over / target in sight / clear / nobody here

mimic_reload.desc: a mimic reloading behind cover: mag out, mag in, the bolt, a word

mimic_scream.desc: a human scream through a dead handset: doubled, crushed, a reversed tail

mimic_shot.desc: a mimic's AK: the report with a thin ghost of static folded in

mimic_skip.desc: the skip: a whoosh with a fast flutter and a reversed shred of voice, gone before you place it

mimic_spot.desc: it has seen you: a low tone drops, static swells, one word

mimic_static.desc: 8 s: the radio hiss it carries, slow crackle, the odd squelch

mimic_step.desc: heavier than a human step on grass and dirt

mission_new.desc: a new contract: the printer and a beep

notify.desc: a quiet notice: one soft tone and paper

nvg_off.desc: night vision off: the whine falling away

nvg_on.desc: night vision powering up: switch, the tube's whine rising

paper_write.desc: a pen on paper: a few strokes

seeker_hiss.desc: hydraulics: a long pressurised hiss and a clank
